title: feat(nm2frm2s3f): directed 2-step cyclic-frame transport along -e3 at t+1 on three-axis far-face opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: Far-face -e3 2-step. The adjacent (0,0,-1)/(0,1,-1) seeds occupy the first hop's destination, so the reverse chain dies immediately; face survives one hop at D only. Convention-stable.
